why: UI-WQ-WEEK-ROUTES: read-only additions for the SPA Work queue 'This week' tab. GET /api/bot/work/items gains optional filters (state=open, owner_prefix, week_lane, q), counts=1 and latest_note=1; a call without them is unchanged. New GET /api/bot/work/lanes (per-AM cards from items + the event log). Two read methods on WorkStore (latest_notes, state_moves_since). No writes, no order path, no new gate.
